title: King Amon is killed by his servants
description: Amon became king of Judah at the age of twenty-two, succeeding his father Manasseh, and reigned two years in Jerusalem. He did what was evil in the Lord's sight, serving the idols his father had served, and abandoned the Lord, the God of his ancestors. His own servants conspired against him and killed the king in his own house. The people of the land struck down the conspirators and made his son Josiah king in his place. Amon was buried in his tomb in the garden of Uzza.
